title: Allora Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: The home is within the beautiful Artist Colony of Ruskin Park in central Seaside where boutique stores and art galleries surround the tranquil tree-lined green space. Remodelled with Restoration Hardware furnishings throughout and an 82-inch state of the art smart TV system in the main living space.
description_expanded: Description304 WEST RUSKIN PLACE2 KINGS, 2 TWINS (can be configured as a third king) 1 BUNKBED, 1 QUEEN MURPHY, 1 QUEEN SLEEPER SOFAA Sophisticated Seaside Retreat for Groups & GatheringsWhether you’re planning a full-family vacation, a girls’ weekend, or a special celebration, Allora is an exceptional Seaside, Florida vacation rental designed to impress. Located in the heart of Ruskin Park, this beautifully remodeled three-story luxury townhome sleeps up to 12 guests and offers four bedrooms, five full bathrooms, and rare flexibility with multiple sleeping configurations—including three king primary suites, bunk accommodations, a queen Murphy bed, and a queen sleeper sofa.Surrounded by tree-lined paths, art galleries, and boutique shops, Ruskin Park is known as Seaside’s artist colony—placing you in one of the most charming and central locations along Scenic Highway 30A.Thoughtfully Designed Living with Elevated StyleRecently renovated and furnished with curated pieces from Restoration Hardware, Allora blends refined design with effortless comfort. One of the home’s most distinctive features is its two separate kitchen areas, making it ideal for entertaining, hosting bridal parties, or multi-generational stays.The primary living space is anchored by a massive 82-inch 4K Smart TV, Apple TV, Blu-ray player, and Sonos cinema surround sound, creating a true in-home theater experience. Personal artwork throughout the living areas adds character and personality, contributing to the home’s bold, modern aesthetic.First Floor | Flexible Sleeping & Private AccessThe first floor offers exceptional privacy and functionality, sleeping up to six guests. A king primary suite includes a Smart TV and a private en-suite bathroom with dual sinks. Nearby, a built-in bunk nook features two twin bunks, each with its own TV, and can be closed off with a louvered folding door for privacy. A full hallway bathroom with a tub/shower combination serves this level.This floor also features a fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances, stone countertops, a breakfast bar, and a European-style combination washer/dryer. The adjacent living area includes a 60-inch Smart TV, Blu-ray player, wireless internet, and a queen sleeper sofa. French doors open to a front patio overlooking Ruskin Park, furnished with Adirondack chairs. An outdoor shower provides a convenient rinse-off after beach days.Second Floor | Gourmet Entertaining & Outdoor LivingAccessible from both front and rear private entrances, the second floor centers around an expansive terrace with outdoor dining space and a natural gas Weber grill, ideal for evening entertaining.Inside, the main living room features an impressive 82-inch 4K Smart TV, Apple TV, Blu-ray player, and Sonos surround sound. A full bathroom with a shower and a laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer are located down the hall.The gourmet kitchen on this level is outfitted with premium appliances, including a Viking gas stove with warming drawers, a Northland refrigerator and freezer, dishwasher, microwave, and a full suite of small appliances for elevated cooking. Beyond the kitchen, the dining room seats eight at a reclaimed elm-wood table and also includes a queen Murphy bed and Sonos sound system. French doors open to a front terrace overlooking Ruskin Park and the Fairy Forest.Third Floor | Spa-Inspired Primary SuitesThe third floor is home to two luxurious king bedrooms. The primary suite is a true sanctuary, featuring a spa-inspired en-suite bathroom with a Kohler rain shower and a Tyrrell & Laing freestanding soaking tub designed for two. The suite includes a 50-inch Smart TV, Apple TV, walk-in closet, dresser, and access to a private terrace—perfect for quiet mornings or sunset relaxation.Down the hall, the second king bedroom can be configured as two twin beds if needed, making it ideal for flexible group arrangements. This room also includes a Smart TV, en-suite bathroom with tub/shower, and generous storage.Rooftop Deck | Elevated Views & Sunset MomentsA striking spiral staircase—positioned over a glass floor—leads to the expansive rooftop deck, where sweeping views of the Gulf and surrounding coastal towns await. Outfitted with loungers, outdoor seating, a bar-height table, Sonos speakers, and a sail shade for afternoon comfort, this rooftop retreat is the perfect place to enjoy sunsets, cocktails, and coastal breezes.Unmatched Location in Central SeasideAllora is just steps from The Chapel at Seaside, boutique shopping, art galleries, and Seaside’s renowned restaurants. The West Ruskin Pavilion beach access—part of Seaside’s private residential beaches and the largest along 30A—is only a 4-minute walk (352 yards) away, making beach days effortless.* 5-night minimum stay Spring and Summer; 7-night Sat to Sat stay for 4th of July 2024; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration.FEATURES2,766 square feet of luxury living spacePrivate Seaside residential beach access at West Ruskin Pavilion (largest private beach on 30A)Approx. 352 yards / 4-minute walk to beach accessThree king primary suites, plus bunk beds, queen Murphy bed, and queen sleeper sofaFive full bathroomsTwo full kitchens with premium appliances82-inch 4K Smart TV with cinema sound and Sonos in main living areaTVs in every bedroomPeacock Alley linens with fresh, luxurious sheets and towels throughoutSteps from The Chapel at SeasideIdeal for bridal parties and group staysAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stayNo pets or smoking permittedSTR23-002231
